title: Add AOM artifact detail and trust status panel
purpose: Make artifact trust, compatibility, revocation and activation preview status legible in the TUI.
scope: Render artifact coordinate, kind, publisher, digest and trust tier.
Render staged, active, blocked, revoked, incompatible and degraded states.
Render activation preview status without activating.
Show why install/stage is inert and activation needs runtime mediation.
acceptance_criteria: Artifact detail explains trust and compatibility state.
Revoked or incompatible artifacts are visibly blocked.
Activation preview shows SecurityExecutionEngine requirement and activation_prepared=false.
No AOM resolver logic is implemented in TUI.
failure_modes: Artifact panel implies staged artifact is active.
Trust UI is treated as policy authority.
